decision: SUPPORTED celebrated.when=evening-before for the independently identified extended form of the Pentecost Vigil

source_argument.fact: The actual title AdMissaminVigiliaPentecostes(p443), and n1 same Missa vigiliae in forma protracta, expressly identify this as the extended form of the named Pentecost VigilMass, not an unrelated Sunday-day form. This primary source also points both opening branches to the same Missa in Vigilia atp443.

Fresh complete page directly read: proper vigil Masses supplied for some solemnities are to be used on the evening of the preceding day if Mass is celebrated at evening hours. Rule concerns proper vigil-Mass timing; this receipt does not treat all anticipatory Masses as proper vigils.

source_argument.source: Same named Pentecost Vigil, registered secondary2002AP265
source_argument.fact: Directly read in mapping round: actual rubric appoints this Mass Saturday evening, before or after FirstVespers of PentecostSunday. It corroborates the general rule in the source-local exact named Mass; no other Vigilform field was merely copied.

finite_inference: The official extended module explicitly belongs to the same proper Pentecost VigilMass; applying the independently read general proper-vigil timing rule therefore supports evening-before. This is a reasoned timing inference from source identity and a stated rule, not an inferred ceremony or completeform identity.

Normae universales de anno liturgico et de calendario n.11, passage.catholic-church.normae-universales-de-anno-liturgico-et-de-calendario.latin-missale-romanum-typica-tertia-2002.complete-text, registered secondary2002 artifact0b458944, p.65: a proper vigil Mass is used on the preceding day's evening when celebrated in evening hours.
